data.name: Deluxe Snorkel and Wildlife Cruise
data.headline: Waikiki's Snorkel and Ocean Playground
data.description:
Cast off on a captivating coastal cruise towards the iconic Diamond Head. Keep your eyes peeled for enchanting encounters with marine life. Spot graceful sea turtles and playful dolphins.

Arrive at our snorkeling site and experience snorkeling on a beautiful coral reef. Snorkeling gear and in-water guides included. You'll have access to our thrilling 20ft waterslide and a bouncy water trampoline that'll have you feeling like a kid again. 

Stay refreshed with complimentary sodas and water with a cash bar for alcoholic beverages onboard. It's the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation!
data.highlights:
- Amazing marine life at our own coral reef snorkel location away from other snorkel boats
- Access to our 2 story waterslide, water trampoline
- Beautiful coastal views of Waikiki and Diamond Head
- More time on the water than other Waikiki snorkel trips
data.itinerary:
1. Coastal marine life cruise with views of Waikiki and Diamond Head searching for turtles, dolphins and more!
2. Anchor at "Rainbow Reef" for snorkeling  and fun in our Ocean Playground with a waterslide, trampoline and lily pad.
3. Relax with a refreshment on a short cruise back to the harbor

data.cancellation_notes:
#Refundable Ticket:
**Cancellation:** Full refund if canceled up to 48 hours before the trip.
**Rebooking:** Free rebooking up to 48 hours before the trip.

All cancellation requests must be submitted in writing at least 48 hours before the trip's start. Reservations made within 48 hours are not eligible for a refund. 

*Refund Requests*

If you would like to request a refund due to unforeseen circumstances please visit our partner [TourClaim](https://link.getcopernican.com/livingoceanscuba) and submit a refund request.


#Non-Refundable Ticket:
**Cancellation:** No refunds, no exceptions
**Rebooking:** Rebooking is allowed up to 48 hours before the trip.

#Private Charter:
**Cancellation:** Full refund if canceled up to 7 Days before the trip.
**Rebooking:** Free rebooking up to 7 Days before the trip.


We suggest traveler’s insurance for any issues such as illness, flight delays, weather delays, and other circumstances that prohibit travel or participation on your part for any of your travel plans.

***NO SHOWS*** to the trip won’t be able to receive a refund OR reschedule your tour. If you arrive later than your scheduled tour time, you will be considered a NO SHOW and won’t be able to receive a refund OR reschedule your tour.

#What if we cancel?

We reserve the right to cancel for any reason, including, but not limited to, weather, ocean conditions, mechanical issues, and safety for you, our guests, and our crew. We’ll do our best to reschedule your trip based on availability, or you’ll be issued a refund in full.
data.booking_notes:
##Sea Sickness
We recommend taking sea sick medication if you are not regularly on the ocean. Please follow the directions on the package / a medical professional. It needs to be taken prior coming to the boat and/or the night before to be affective. Sea sickness medication is available as an over the counter medication at local pharmacies. As it needs to be taken prior to arrival we do not have sea sickness medication available on the boat. 

##What to Bring
- Towels
- Hat, Sunglasses, Sunscreen
- Wear Swimming Attire
- Cameras
- Crew Gratuity (not required)

**Full Face Masks** - For your safety we do not permit full snorkeling masks on our tours

###Additional Information

**Sea Sickness** - Generally the ocean is calm near Waikiki, but if you are prone to sea sickness or are not accustomed to being aboard ocean going boats we suggest you consult your doctor or pharmacist about taking preventative measures prior to your trip.

**Departure Time / Late Arrivals**  - Out of respect to our guests we attempt to leave on time for every trip. If you are running late and do not arrive at the boat prior to the scheduled departure time your ticket will be forfeited. Refunds cannot be processed for no-shows / late arrivals so please plan ahead and arrive on time.

*Refund Requests*

If you would like to request a refund due to unforeseen circumstances please visit our partner [TourClaim](https://link.getcopernican.com/livingoceanscuba) and submit a refund request.
